steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la
echo "--- input head ---"
head -5 input.csv
echo "--- expected head ---"
head -5 expected.csv
echo "--- sizes ---"
wc -l input.csv expected.csv 2>/dev/null || wc -l /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import collections
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
lines=data.split(b'\n')
print("num lines", len(lines), "trailing", repr(lines[-1]))
print("CR?", b'\r' in data)
# field counts
cc=collections.Counter()
bad=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if not l: continue
    cc[l.count(b',')]+=1
print("comma counts", cc)
# look at odd examples
for i,l in enumerate(lines[:20]):
    print(i, repr(l))
print("--- last lines")
for l in lines[-5:]:
    print(repr(l))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
which vim; vim --version | head -2
head -5 input.csv > /tmp/in.csv
cat > /tmp/t.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*\\([^,]*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\([^,]*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\([^,]*\\)\\s*/\\U\\1;\\2;\\3/\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\([^;]*\\);\\s*\\([^;]*\\);\\s*\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/in.csv -S /tmp/t.vim; echo "exit=$?"
cat /tmp/in.csv
echo "--- expected"
head -5 expected.csv
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
bad=0; examples=[]
maxlen=0
with open('input.csv') as f:
    for i,l in enumerate(f):
        parts=l.rstrip('\n').split(',')
        assert len(parts)==3
        for p in parts:
            t=p.strip()
            if ' ' in t or '\t' in t:
                bad+=1
                if len(examples)<10: examples.append((i,repr(p)))
            maxlen=max(maxlen,len(t))
        if i>200000 and bad==0:
            pass
print("internal-space fields:",bad,examples,"maxlen",maxlen)
# verify expected structure
import re
pat=re.compile(r'^[^;]*;[^;]*;[^;]*;OK$')
bad2=0
with open('expected.csv') as f:
    for i,l in enumerate(f):
        if not pat.match(l.rstrip('\n')):
            bad2+=1
            if bad2<5: print("odd expected",i,repr(l))
print("bad expected lines",bad2)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
head -5 input.csv > /tmp/in.csv
cat > /tmp/t.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*/\\U\\1;\\2;\\3/\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/in.csv -S /tmp/t.vim; echo "exit=$?"
cat /tmp/in.csv
echo "--- diff"
head -5 expected.csv | diff - /tmp/in.csv && echo SAME
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
cat > apply_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*/\\U\\1;\\2;\\3/\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/$/;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
cp input.csv /tmp/full.csv
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/full.csv -S apply_macros.vim; echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/full.csv expected.csv && echo "BYTE-IDENTICAL"
# count macro keystrokes as expanded
python3 - <<'PY'
a=r":s/\s*\(\S*\)\s*,\s*\(\S*\)\s*,\s*\(\S*\)\s*/\U\1;\2;\3/\r"
b=r":s/\([^;]*\);\([^;]*\);\(.*\)/\3;\2;\1/\r"
c=r":s/$/;OK/\r"
print(len(a),len(b),len(c),"total",len(a)+len(b)+len(c))
PY
echo "--- script ---"
cat apply_macros.vim
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
lines=open('apply_macros.vim').read().splitlines()
total=0
for l in lines[:3]:
    m=re.search(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"',l)
    s=m.group(1)
    # raw script chars between quotes
    print(repr(s), "rawlen",len(s), "backslashes",s.count('\\'))
    total+=len(s)
print("raw content total",total)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "vim exit=$?"
cmp /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv && echo "BYTE-IDENTICAL"
ls -l /app/apply_macros.vim
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
# synthesize original-style sample from expected first 5 lines
python3 - <<'PY'
out=[]
for l in open('expected.csv').read().splitlines()[:5]:
    a,b,c,ok=l.split(';')
    out.append(f"   {c}  ,   {b} ,  {a}  ")
open('/tmp/orig5.csv','w').write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
open('/tmp/exp5.csv','w').write("\n".join(open('expected.csv').read().splitlines()[:5])+"\n")
PY
cat > /tmp/idem.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*/\\U\\1;\\2;\\3/e\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/^\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)$/\\3;\\2;\\1/e\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/^\\(\\([^;]*;\\)\\{2}[^;]*\\)$/\\1;OK/e\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
echo "== first run =="
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/orig5.csv -S /tmp/idem.vim; echo "exit=$?"
diff /tmp/orig5.csv /tmp/exp5.csv && echo "MATCH after run1"
echo "== second run (idempotency) =="
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/orig5.csv -S /tmp/idem.vim; echo "exit=$?"
diff /tmp/orig5.csv /tmp/exp5.csv && echo "MATCH after run2"
cat /tmp/orig5.csv
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
for l in open('/tmp/idem.vim').read().splitlines()[:3]:
    s=re.search(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"',l).group(1)
    print(len(s), repr(s))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
# build a full synthetic original (varied whitespace incl tabs) from expected
python3 - <<'PY'
with open('/app/expected.csv') as f, open('/tmp/orig_full.csv','w') as o:
    for i,l in enumerate(f):
        a,b,c,ok=l.rstrip('\n').split(';')
        if i%3==0: o.write(f"\t {c}  ,\t{b}   ,   {a} \n")
        elif i%3==1: o.write(f"  {c}, {b}\t,{a}\t\n")
        else: o.write(f"   {c}   ,   {b}  ,  {a}   \n")
PY
cat > /app/apply_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*,\\s*\\(\\S*\\)\\s*/\\U\\1;\\2;\\3/e\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/^\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)$/\\3;\\2;\\1/e\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/^\\(\\([^;]*;\\)\\{2}[^;]*\\)$/\\1;OK/e\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/orig_full.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "full orig exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/orig_full.csv /app/expected.csv && echo "FULL ORIG->EXPECTED BYTE-IDENTICAL"
# idempotency on the real current input (already expected)
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "current exit=$?"
cmp /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv && echo "CURRENT STILL BYTE-IDENTICAL"
echo "--- final script ---"; cat /app/apply_macros.vim
EOF
